newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore names new ambassador to Australia.
newsitem.headline: Singapore names new ambassador to Australia.

text.p: Singapore has named Low Choon Ming, the republic's former high commissioner to Malaysia, as its next ambassador to Australia, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs said in a statement on Saturday.
It said Low, a career diplomat, had served in Bangkok, New Delhi and Cairo since joining the foreign service in 1968. He was previously the high commissioner to Australia and Fiji from 1980 to 1986.
In a separate statement, the ministry also said it had appointed Brian Lee, a university professor, as ambassador to Kuwait and Oman. Lee will reside in Singapore, it said.
